acceptance: Registration rejects duplicate ids, unknown ids, unresolved kinds, claims without passing witnesses, ambiguous recognitions and capability or mode mismatches; recognition honors exclusions and precedence.

positive.fixture: a complete implemented primitive registers; the highest precedence wins and exclusions hold

negative.fixture: duplicates, ambiguity, malformed recognitions and capability mismatches are rejected
negative.command: cargo test --manifest-path compiler/Cargo.toml --locked -p vsf-registry --test registry -- registration_rejects_duplicates_unknown_ids_and_unresolved_kinds ambiguous_recognitions_are_rejected_unless_exclusive_or_ordered malformed_recognitions_are_rejected capability_mismatches_and_unknown_modes_are_rejected

security_and_source_permissions: Registry data carries no credentials; no real source app was observed, and source-account permissions stay outside the registry.
performance_memory_storage: Ambiguity check compares recognitions pairwise per produced type.
known_limitations: Recognition signatures are structural predicates only; richer matching waits for B04 observation
